issues.legal_issue: A deed conveying all present and future rights in property, while reserving no rights to the transferor, transfers the transferor’s contractual right to reconveyance.
material_facts: The claimant sought specific performance of a contract that gave the transferor a right to reconveyance of the property.
The claimant obtained a sale deed from the transferor.
The sale deed stated that all rights and privileges in or concerning the property, whether present or accruing in the future, were conveyed.
The sale deed stated that the transferor retained no right of any kind.
issues.conclusion: The right to reconveyance was transferred to the claimant, who was entitled to the specific-performance decree sought.
issues.legal_principle: The Court construed the sale deed as a whole and held that its operative terms conveying all present and future rights in the property, with none retained by the transferor, included the contractual right to reconveyance. The judgment cites no statutory provision or earlier case for this conclusion.

rule.if: specific_performance_suit and transferor_held_reconveyance_right and deed_transferred_rights_to_claimant and deed_conveyed_all_present_and_future_property_rights and transferor_retained_no_rights

predicates.specific_performance_suit: The claimant brought a suit seeking specific performance of a contract.
predicates.transferor_held_reconveyance_right: The person who later transferred the property held a contractual right to reconveyance.
predicates.deed_transferred_rights_to_claimant: The transferor executed a deed conveying rights in the property to the claimant.
predicates.deed_conveyed_all_present_and_future_pro: The deed stated that all present and future rights in or concerning the property held by the transferor were conveyed.
predicates.transferor_retained_no_rights: The deed stated that the transferor retained no rights.
predicates.claimant_entitled_to_specific_performanc: The claimant is entitled to a decree for specific performance.

issues.definition: When a claimant seeks specific performance, the transferor held a contractual reconveyance right, and the deed to the claimant conveyed all present and future property rights while reserving none to the transferor, the claimant is entitled to a specific-performance decree.
